notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter release date
notes.notes:
[h2]Big news, Fossil Hunters! [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/e7be83bb6e5a42c81f0360507c944ecd224cf512.png[/img]

We can finally share this information with all of you – [b]Dinosaur Fossil Hunter will be released on April 27[/b]! Make sure to mark this date in your calendar so you can prepare accordingly and save some spare time for fossil hunting!

Here is the latest trailer of the game to give you an idea what to expect!

[previewyoutube=C4WP6SPQDWU;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4WP6SPQDWU[/previewyoutube]

With this announcement, [b]we're now closing registration for Beta playtests[/b] – that said, playtests are still ongoing!

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Dinosaur Fossil Hunter featured at PAX! – Update for the Prologue goes LIVE!
notes.notes:
Exciting news, Fossil Hunters!

We have more surprises for you today! As it turns out, Dinosaur Fossil Hunter is featured at Camp PAX West Seattle 2021! 🥳 To celebrate, we're unveiling the [b]major Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Demo & Prologue update[/b] we have been working on alongside the full version of the game! It means that we’ve brought many of the long-awaited new features to Prologue and you can try them out today!

Here is the list of changes:
[list]
[*] translations added, available languages: English, Italian, Polish, German, Chinese, Russian, Spanish, French
[*] redesigned tutorial system [new screens, additional descriptions, waypoints etc.]
[*] redesigned UI screens [except tablet UI, WIP]
[*] upgraded map functionality [selecting and navigating to specific points]
[*] reworked exposure design system
[*] upgraded exploration workflow (new tool)
[*] upgraded excavation workflow [new steps and tools]
[*] improved fossil cleaning system [added possibility to highlight uncleaned areas, smoother tool work]
[*] improved vehicle camera
[*] improved models look & quality
[*] improved tools and tent animations
[*] improved skeleton assembling system [faster bone movement, added ability to put down]
[*] added drone for environmental screenshots
[*] visual polish & optimization
[*] many bugs reported by players have been fixed
[/list]

Have fun, explore and when you're done, make sure to share your feedback with us! We'd like to make use of this opportunity to gather your suggestions and make Dinosaur Fossil Hunter as good as possible! Let us know what you like and what may require more attention from us. It will help us greatly during further development. 😊

We’ll be awaiting your feedback on Steam forums and our [b][url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Discord server[/url][/b] while – of course – continuously working on Dinosaur Fossil Hunter! 💪

Make sure to add it to your Wishlist so you don’t miss any announcements! With that, the only thing that’s left is to wish you all a good time with the Prologue! 
Best Regards,

Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/864700/Dinosaur_Fossil_Hunter/

notes.title: Improved skeleton models, field trip and upcoming Prologue update!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello, Fossil Hunters![/h3]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rY07Rbu.gif[/img]

Now that we have finished working on gameplay mechanics that will be included in the game, we are now focused on improvements. That includes thorough testing, gathering feedback, making tweaks and balancing the gameplay and also making improvements in terms of performance. 

At the same time, we have also taken our time analyzing feedback from Steam, our Discord channel and other sources that you have provided us since the last prologue update. Based on that, we've picked out some gameplay elements that could be improved or added and we are also taking them into account while developing the game further.

[u]Here are some things we have been working on recently:[/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/9511f2a3dee38bcfea5bc070995687ee4afb5c17.jpg[/img]

Thanks to our team members who have done thorough research and paleontologists who provided us with invaluable feedback, [b]we have significantly improved the quality of our in-game dinosaur skeletons[/b]! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eSImewy.gif[/img]

They are now much more detailed and anatomically close to real skeletons. Now, we are working on improving existing poses.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EOjPhGa.gif[/img]

As we have already mentioned, while we're working on balancing the gameplay progression, [b]the QA team is handling the internal testing[/b] and providing us the feedback necessary for further improvements.

Now a little fun fact: some of us had the opportunity to gain field experience by [b]participating in paleontological research ourselves[/b]! 😃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/65b0527eacaa6b6da33f0339a850216811de29d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/d30511bf81f8bf61dc9b6c84264ef5f342be5de9.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/9f6ce512dafe421eca8de02917d22ab152519184.jpg[/img]

[b]We're also preparing an update for the Prologue version of the game[/b] – we have added many new gameplay mechanics that will be also included in the full version of the game. This update will come with an expanded tutorial, which will explain newly added mechanics. We hope that will make it much easier for you to jump right into the full game and start your adventure. 😉

Thank you for your interest in Dinosaur Fossil Hunter! Your feedback is a great help to us and we hope to write even more about changes made in the upcoming devlog! 

If you have something to share with us, we invite you to join our Discord channel.

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Prologue Update IV is now live!
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Paleontologists! [/h1]

[b]Dinosaur Fossil Hunter: Prologue is now live! [/b] This update brings some big changes. The biggest one is [b]the key binding system[/b], [b]interactive cursor[/b] as well as [b]the additional autosave point in the garage.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/2b186c5d9118c22b3af69afedc7647036c2a0dbd.png[/img]

[u][h3]Update IV Changelog[/h3][/u]
[u][b]List of improvements:[/b][/u]
[list] [*] added key bindings
[*] added an interactive cursor to improve field work with tools
[*] inversion of the Y camera axis for the car
[*] improved car camera control
[*] improved gameplay optimization
[*] improved environment look and post-processing
[*] improved terrain textures
[*] improved sky and clouds
[*] improved swimming
[*] improved some sounds
[*] improved dust material on the fossil
[*] improved and rebaked occlusion [/list]

[u][b]Bug fixes:[/b][/u]
[list] [*] fixed “Scrap it” achievement bug
[*] fixed toy assembly bug
[*] fixed bug at bus scene
[*] fixed disappearing cursor
[*] fixed museum exposition bugs
[*] fixed restoring removed objects after loading
[*] fixed bugs with gameplay controls tips
[*] fixed doubled resolutions in the game settings
[*] fixed blackscreen while getting out of the car and resetting at the same time [/list]
[b]Warning: introducing these changes forced us to delete previous game saves.[/b]
As the Prologue story is linear we hope it won't be a big problem for you. This is a necessary step to introduce key bindings, new save system and to make the whole game better. We apologize for this inconvenience and thank you for your understanding. 

[u][b]Below you can take a look at some of the improvements: [/b][/u]

[b]Interactive cursor (animation):[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/rCCqvbd.gif[/img]

[b]Improved terrain textures:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32825646/6203a0dde401b54ab2136d3a1a307fc2eda72b90.png[/img]

If you would like to talk about the game with other players and developers, don't hesitate to join our [url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh]Discord[/url]! 

[url=https://discord.gg/sv9UWeh][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37978213/c8d6f8bc0cb4488b1423dc8803422518ed92f6d4.png[/img][/url]

[h3]We wish you all a Happy New Year![/h3]

Sincerely,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team

notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear Paleontologists![/h1]

[b]New update for the Prologue is live! [/b] This update contains bug fixes and other additional changes. Based on your feedback, we've manage to improve the Prologue version, and make the gameplay more enjoyable. Below you can see the list of changes and improvements. 

[b]Update III (20.08.2020) III Changelog[/b]
[list] [*] added possibility to hide controls under F1 button
[*] added possibility to hide tablet with ESC button
[*] added possibility to change camera distance from car with scroll
[*] upgraded fueling speed and fixed particles at additional canisters
[*] increased max camera sensivity value
[*] decreased running speed at museum
[*] fixed blocker at museum parking
[*] fixed blocker at grandpa’s garage
[*] fixed colliders at mine
[*] fixed Y-axis invert for car
[*] fixed “dot” cursor
[*] optimized game size and performance [/list]

If you didn't try out the Prologue version yet, don't hesitate to play! We will appreciate your feedback. If you have more suggestions regarding the game or just want to talk with devs, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/35dda2a]Discord server[/url]! 

Best Regards,
Dinosaur Fossil Hunter Team
